problem: The recorder retained execution ticks but discarded command arrival times. Queuing a command at tick0 to execute at4 made its own five-tick recording diverge at0, because verification omitted the earlier pending queue. The verifier also ignored the declared end interval and could overlook submissions outside it.

interface.timeline: submissions contain the actual arrival tick and immutable command copy, in arrival order
interface.finalChecksum: Includes accepted commands queued after the last advance, including zero-tick recordings
interface.compatibility: Format1 remains readable with its original execution-tick-as-arrival interpretation. Missing historical arrival times cannot be reconstructed. The save schema and rules catalog are unchanged.
interface.diagnostics: Preserves existing first divergent transition labels; final snapshot errors use the end tick. Malformed intervals, arrival ordering and checksums throw TypeError; invalid advances are rejected before changing state.

outstanding: Native and browser runtime replay comparison
scope: Completed timeline and validation correction at the shared public engine interface. S3-092 remains open for its remaining platform and version acceptance.
